calibration_note: Rebuilt 2026-07-30: the Trend Engine's estimate_runs() formula was changed from an implicit exponent-1.0 assumption on every factor (offense, opposing starter weakness, opposing bullpen weakness, park, weather) to real elasticities fit via a Poisson GLM against 629 real games spanning 2024-02 to 2026-07 (see mlb-analyst-poisson-trend-v0.2.yaml's offense_elasticity etc. and its comments for the full fit methodology and chronological cross-validation). This artifact's own scale/offset were then refit the same way as the 2026-07-29 version: OLS of the REBUILT formula's raw simulated cover probability against real cover outcomes, same 162-game/2026-07-01..07-12 window (real historical Polymarket-reconstructed spread lines, real final scores, point-in-time-correct features). Correlation with real outcomes: 0.062 (previous four formula revisions on 2026-07-29 ranged 0.045-0.12, so this sits within that range -- margin did not improve much from the elasticity rebuild, unlike totals; see measured-edge-totals-v1.json for that result). Flat -110 diagnostic: 80 selected picks, 53.7% hit rate, +2.09 units. Still real but small evidence on a 162-game sample -- treat as diagnostic, not proof, same as before.
